CustomField.formula: IF( ELV_CustomerQuote__c, "Direct", IF( AND( ELV_PartnerQuote__c, OR( ELV_Azure_Marketplace__c, ELV_AWS_Marketplace__c, ELV_Marketplace_Partner__c ) ), "Marketplace", IF( ELV_PartnerQuote__c, "Partner", "Invalid Combination of Customer, Partner, & Marketplace Partner" ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Determines quote template based on Customer Quote, Partner Quote, and Marketplace Partner Fields.
CustomField.label: Template Selection
